name: Customer Greeting Flow with Template Filters
description: Example flow demonstrating Template Runtime v1 filter usage

welcome_known.text: Hi {{tool.magnus.customer.customer.name | default:"valued customer" | upper}}! Your account status is {{tool.magnus.customer.customer.status | default:"active"}}. Press 1 for sales, 2 for support, or 9 to hear your details.

welcome_unknown.text: Welcome to our service! Press 1 to become a new customer, 2 for general inquiries.

customer_details.text: Your name is {{tool.magnus.customer.customer.name}}, email {{tool.magnus.customer.customer.email | lower}}, calling from {{session.caller | digits}}. Press star to return to menu.

input.notes: New customer inquiry. DTMF selection: {{session.last_dtmf | default:"none"}}

confirm_lead.text: Thank you! We've created your inquiry with ID {{tool.magnus.lead.leadId | default:"pending"}}. Someone will contact you at {{session.caller | digits}} soon. Press 1 to continue.

lead_error.text: Sorry, we couldn't process your request right now. Please try again later or press 0 for operator.

sales_menu.text: Sales menu. Press 1 for pricing, 2 for demos, or 0 to speak with a sales rep.

support_menu.text: Support menu. Press 1 for technical support, 2 for billing, or 0 for operator.

general_info.text: For general information, visit our website or press star to return to the main menu.

pricing_info.text: Our plans start at 49 dollars per month. Press star to return to sales menu.

demo_info.text: To schedule a demo, press 1 now.

tech_support.text: For technical support, please hold while we transfer you.

billing_support.text: For billing inquiries, please hold while we transfer you.

transfer_support.text: Transferring to technical support. Please hold.

timeout_message.text: Sorry, we didn't receive your selection. Press star to return to the main menu or hang up to end the call.

end.text: Thank you for calling {{tool.magnus.customer.customer.name | default:"us"}}. Goodbye!
